findings.ac: Exactly one module declares either canonical set (invariant 1)
findings.text: The single-declaration test in BT169_CanonicalTaxonomy.test.js only scans for the job-function set (files containing both 'business_ops' and 'regulatory'); nothing scans for the sector set, and api/submit.js declares its own SECTORS array (nine keys, incl. agri_and_food and water_and_nature, not in the live seven) while api/enrich.js hardcodes a sector enum in its prompt, so the 'either canonical set' grep claim is unproven for sectors.

findings.ac: Time-to-Value live dispatch (batch_size 5, dry_run false) and two consecutive nightly runs with last_checked_at advanced
findings.text: These live-production ACs have no test or recorded evidence in the packet (BT169_DryRun.test.js only covers the dry-run and control paths with a mocked client); they remain unverified pending human-authorised runs.
